recentItems.title: 'Unofficially Yours' FULL MOVIE | Angel Locsin, John Lloyd Cruz
recentItems.description:
Depressed Macky (John Lloyd Cruz) is recovering from a recent failed relationship. One night, he meets Ces (Angel Locsin), a woman afraid of commitment, and they have a one-night stand. They later bump into each other as co-workers when Macky starts his new job as a reporter. Released in 2012 and directed by Cathy Garcia-Sampana.

Starring Angel Locsin, John Lloyd Cruz, Edgar Mortiz, Tetchie Agbayani, and Edgar Allan Guzman.
